name: kotlin-plugin
description: Kotlin/JVM backend stack provider for the SDLC marketplace (priority=120). Detects the Kotlin JVM plugin in Gradle or Maven build files. Adds kotlin-architect agent (Sonnet/medium) for Kotlin libraries, CLIs and services (Ktor, plain JVM), plus kotlin-conventions, kotlin-coroutines and kotlin-testing skills (JUnit 5 / Kotest, MockK, runTest). Beats java-plugin (100); spring-boot-plugin (150) still wins on Spring projects. Reuses java-foundation build tooling.
